decisions.reason: The bleaching tray blank line has several models, its own web page, and fits the firm's core thermoforming materials business, so the investment and visible commitment favor keeping it.
The PETG thermoforming blank is a core consumable in the firm's established dental lab material range, has a dedicated page, and requires little ongoing investment to keep.
The UV-curing lacquer is only mentioned on the website, a sign of weaker commitment, but it complements the firm's digital and lab workflows and costs little to retain.

The custom hearing protection line belongs to the firm's central custom-device and hearing-care business and its digital manufacturing direction, so management persists with it even though the related earmold line E was withdrawn.
